verse_extra: gists with no account and a passphrase lock

first_page: Repo reader page /repo/ for people who want to read a public repository fast. First: a-to-mind.com/repo/?r=owner/name opens the file tree, any file through the existing gh-file viewer, the commit list with one commit's diff, and open issues and PRs as readable lists, all read live from public GitHub with no token and cached at the edge. Will not build: hosting, pushing, Actions, reviews or accounts.
